Authorities filed over twenty-three thousand charges against twenty-four suspects in this significant legal proceeding.

The court heard a plea challenging Karnataka's Premium Floor Area Ratio scheme. This scheme allows purchasing additional construction rights by paying premium charges. title: Rani Mukerji's mother's funeral: SRK, Alia, Anil Kapoor arrive to pay last respects
description: In a heartbreaking turn of events, Rani Mukerji's mother, Krishna Mukerji, has died at seventy-five, as confirmed by Yash Raj Films, which also asked for family privacy. Friends from the film industry, including Shah Rukh Khan, gathered to pay their respects at the funeral on Tuesday. Krishna was instrumental in nurturing Rani's passion for acting from an early age. Rani’s recent projects include 'Mardaani 3' and the upcoming film 'King.'

title: Asian Games Medal Tally: Where does India rank after women's cricket retains gold?
description: India’s women's cricket team showcased their prowess once again, winning the gold medal at the Asian Games for the second time. Under the captaincy of Harmanpreet Kaur, they triumphed over Sri Lanka by an impressive 147 runs. This victory elevates India's medal standings to one gold, four silver, and two bronze, with anticipation building as more events, including badminton and wushu, unfold.

title: Embassy sells Juhu tower to Angel One founder Thakkar for Rs 711 cr
description: Embassy Developments has finalized a pivotal MoU for a luxury residential sale involving an entire tower at Embassy Terrazza located in Juhu. Dinesh Thakkar, the founder of Angel One, has acquired this prestigious residence, with the deal amounting to around Rs 711 crore, inclusive of all expenses. This transaction stands as the largest single residential unit sale for the developer in India.

title: 'I'm going to tell the truth': Netanyahu hits back at Mamdani ahead of UN speech
description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is set to deliver a significant address at the United Nations General Assembly. In his speech, he intends to staunchly defend military operations conducted by Israel while also targeting New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani. Netanyahu has accused Mamdani of endorsing Hamas and fostering anti-Jewish sentiment, in response to Mamdani's previous remarks labeling him a war criminal responsible for genocide.

title: Asiad: India win 1st gold, assure medals in badminton, wushu on action-packed day

The men's badminton team and wushu star Roshibina Devi assured medals, while hockey, boxing and gymnastics produced strong results amid mixed fortunes in shooting and table tennis.

title: Yash Dayal back in Uttar Pradesh Ranji Trophy camp

He is being included in the Uttar Pradesh Ranji Trophy camp, starting on Friday in Lucknow. Dayal has not played any competitive cricket since the IPL 2025 final, which RCB won.

title: Gunmen kill 2 cops during polio vaccination drive in Pakistan's Balochistan
description: On Tuesday, gunmen in Balochistan province of Pakistan killed two police officers while they were safeguarding a door-to-door polio vaccination campaign. Thankfully, the health workers giving oral vaccine drops escaped without injury. Sadly, this incident highlights the ongoing security challenges that hamper vaccination drives in Pakistan, leaving it and Afghanistan as the last countries grappling with wild poliovirus transmission.

title: MediaTek targets Qualcomm's fortress with an unmatched new weapon
description: MediaTek has taken the lead over Qualcomm by launching the Dimensity 9600 Pro—the world’s first flagship smartphone chip built on TSMC’s 2nm process. The move signals MediaTek's aggressive push into the premium Android market, offering top-tier performance, efficiency, camera power, and on-device AI at a competitive price.

title: Foreign cycling coach booked under POCSO for 'raping' minor athlete; passport seized
description: A 34-year-old Kazakhstan coach attached to the Indian cycling squad has been booked under the POCSO Act for allegedly raping a minor cyclist at the National Centre of Excellence in Patiala. Police have issued a lookout circular against Maxat Ayazbayev, seized his passport and formed two teams to trace him after he allegedly went untraceable following the complaint. The Cycling Federation of India has also suspended him, while raids are underway in Delhi and the NCR.

title: Idaho teacher retires, drives across US to provide 30 hours of childcare a week
description: A 67-year-old retired schoolteacher from Idaho moved across the US to Delaware after her daughter became pregnant with her second child and faced high childcare costs. Mary Jo Galusha now spends about 30 hours each week caring for her granddaughter while her daughter and son-in-law work, highlighting how families are increasingly relying on grandparents for childcare.

72nd National Awards: Mammootty receives standing ovation, Dhanush honoured
description: Mammootty and Dhanush received their National Film Awards from President Droupadi Murmu, with both stars making classic appearances at the ceremony. Mammootty won Best Actor for 'Bramayugam,' while Dhanush’s 'Raayan' was honoured as Best Tamil Film, with his sons Yatra and Linga witnessing the moment. Their National Award reunion, along with director Rajkumar Periasamy and editor R Kalaivanan’s honours, has further raised expectations for 'OM.'

title: Who is Roshibina? Wushu star who faced selection row before assuring herself a medal
description: Naorem Roshibina Devi assured herself a third successive Asian Games medal after defeating Macao, China’s Chu Man Sin 5-0 in the women’s Sanda 60kg quarterfinal at Aichi-Nagoya. The Manipuri wushu star, who won bronze in 2018 and silver in 2023, reached the semifinals after a selection controversy preceded her return to the squad.

title: India-Japan T20I wide row: What laws say about umpire's reversal of decision
description: Japan needed six runs from the last four balls while chasing India's 32 for 4. But the match took another turn when a wide call was reversed after protests from India.

title: China building new next-generation submarine as India's numbers stay constant
description: Fresh satellite imagery of China’s Bohai Shipyard shows a submarine believed to be a possible Type 095 nuclear-powered attack submarine under construction. The vessel features an apparent pumpjet propulsion system and X-shaped stern, suggesting efforts to improve stealth, efficiency and manoeuvrability. The development has regional implications as Pakistan expands its submarine fleet with eight Chinese-designed Hangor-class AIP submarines, expected to raise its fleet to 11. India operates 16 conventional and three strategic submarines, but fleet expansion has been delayed. Programmes including P-75I, Project-76 and indigenous nuclear attack submarines are progressing, but deliveries remain years away.

Environmental and tribal groups challenged the deal, citing ecological, cultural and historical concerns, but the judge said they had provided limited evidence of potential harm.

title: Asian Games: Saurav Ghosal identifies India's biggest challenge, and incentive
description: Saurav Ghosal is watching his first Asian Games without a racquet in hand since 2002, but India's former squash star believes the country's medal hopes have never been clearer. As mentor to Anahat Singh, Ghosal discusses handling expectations, the significance of Olympic qualification, and why medals -- not promise -- must define India's squash campaign in Aichi-Nagoya.

title: India’s space sovereignty: From building missions to building depth
description: India has proven its capability to design and launch complex spacecraft independently.  The nation now focuses on building industrial depth for space sovereignty and self-reliance.  A burgeoning private sector and numerous startups are transforming India's space ecosystem.  Future missions aim for a space station and lunar exploration by 2040.  Component-level self-reliance remains a critical challenge for sustained space endeavors.

title: 7pm temple, 7.30 park, 8.45 PCR call: Timeline of how 3 fake cops gang-raped Delhi teen
description: A 17-year-old girl was allegedly gang-raped by three men in Astha Kunj Park. The accused posed as police officers and separated her from her male friend. One assailant allegedly threatened the girl with a firearm and a knife during the assault. Police received a PCR call and later apprehended one accused, Asif, after an exchange of fire.

title: Cristiano Ronaldo and Georgina Rodríguez’s $25m plot: What are they building?
description: Cristiano Ronaldo and Georgina Rodríguez bought a €25 million plot on Dubai’s Jumeirah Bay Island in 2024 and planned a custom family mansion there. The move followed their decision to rent out their Madrid home for €10,000 a month. The Dubai property gives the family a major base closer to Ronaldo’s life with Al-Nassr in Saudi Arabia.

title: Naomi Osaka’s family faced eviction before her Grand Slam success
description: During the evolution of her remarkable tennis career, which boasts four Grand Slam titles and a peak world ranking of number one, Naomi Osaka navigated challenging eviction notices. Beyond her athletic achievements, she has ventured into investments and sports ownership, notably launching successful skincare and media companies. Currently, she is ambitiously embracing luxury fashion projects, showcasing her versatility beyond the tennis court.
